sentence: Flanged housing for a 608 bearing: H7 seat, shoulder, retaining-ring groove, four-bolt flange
design_notes: One revolve profile (seat 22 H7 as an ISO 286 class parameter, zone [22, 22.021] from the tables; hub to z = 17.1 so the land above the ring groove is 2.1 mm: the agent first had 1.5, which the wall check certified as a fail, then exactly 2, which an outward-rounded bound cannot decide against >= 2, shoulder bore 19), flange 64 x 6 with four M5 clearance holes (ISO 273 record) on a 50 PCD at 45 deg, and a DIN 472 groove built by the groove feature from the 22 seat at the bearing end (z 13.9), notched into the revolve profile.
